title: Ctrl/Cmd on a resize or rotate handle starts a brush with the wrong cursor
reason: Reports tldraw routing accelerator presses on transform handles into brush mode while retaining the transform cursor. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no matching handle-to-brush accelerator route; its selection transform and brush interactions are separate. This cursor-state report does not identify a matching Varve path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no matching handle-to-brush accelerator route; its selection transform and brush interactions are separate. This cursor-state report does not identify a matching Varve path.

title: A bookmark is left behind when resizing a multi-selection
reason: Reports a fixed-size bookmark omitted from a multi-selection resize snapshot, while other fixed-size content moves with the selection. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's scene model has no bookmark/embed node corresponding to the reported fixed-size shape utility; do not infer a general multi-selection transform defect from this upstream-specific omission.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's scene model has no bookmark/embed node corresponding to the reported fixed-size shape utility; do not infer a general multi-selection transform defect from this upstream-specific omission.

title: Highlighter strokes inside a frame render faint
reason: Reports that tldraw's two-pass highlighter underlay is obscured by opaque frame backgrounds. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's highlighter is rendered through its own stroke/render path rather than a separate background pass; the specific frame-background compositing failure has no matching implementation path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's highlighter is rendered through its own stroke/render path rather than a separate background pass; the specific frame-background compositing failure has no matching implementation path.

title: "Send to back" has no effect on an arrow bound to a shape
reason: Reports bound arrows being restacked above their bound shapes after an explicit send-to-back action; the sole comment calls this a decision rather than a bug.
assessment: The maintainer explicitly classifies this as a product decision. Varve's scene arrow binding does not promise tldraw's automatic restacking contract, so this is not a Varve defect.

varveAssessment.assessment: The maintainer explicitly classifies this as a product decision. Varve's scene arrow binding does not promise tldraw's automatic restacking contract, so this is not a Varve defect.

title: Arrow label drag reverts when a menu opens or undo is pressed mid-drag
reason: Reports a label-position drag being cancelled on gesture completion when a menu opens or undo occurs. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's arrow node currently has no independently draggable label-position interaction matching this state path; the specific rollback defect is not transferable.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's arrow node currently has no independently draggable label-position interaction matching this state path; the specific rollback defect is not transferable.

title: Pressing Enter starts cropping an image in a readonly room
reason: Reports Enter entering crop state in a hosted readonly session. Reproduction requires a sync server and no comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no hosted readonly-room collaboration mode, so the permission-state scenario is outside the current product boundary.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no hosted readonly-room collaboration mode, so the permission-state scenario is outside the current product boundary.

title: Exiting crop mode without cancelling leaves the image marked as the cropping shape
reason: Reports tldraw crop state retaining a global cropping-shape marker when leaving by tool/page/duplicate routes. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's CropTool.onDeactivate clears its transient crop state, node id, and node size on every tool exit, so the reported stale marker lifecycle does not match Varve's implementation.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's CropTool.onDeactivate clears its transient crop state, node id, and node size on every tool exit, so the reported stale marker lifecycle does not match Varve's implementation.

title: Deleting a frame deletes its locked children
reason: Reports recursive deletion of locked descendants while deleting an unlocked parent; the upstream report explicitly says expected detached-child versus refusal semantics are unresolved.
assessment: Varve's scene removal is recursive, but changing it to preserve locked descendants would require defining valid parent detachment and undo semantics across all containers. The source report leaves that product decision open, so no mutation is justified from this comparison alone.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's scene removal is recursive, but changing it to preserve locked descendants would require defining valid parent detachment and undo semantics across all containers. The source report leaves that product decision open, so no mutation is justified from this comparison alone.

title: Undecodable image file aborts the whole file drop with no error toast
reason: Reports one malformed image aborting a mixed tldraw file drop before valid siblings are committed. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's ImportService.importFiles invokes a per-file importer that converts parser/decode exceptions into a failed file report, continues the worker queue, and preserves report order; CanvasArea commits the valid artifacts and announces failures. The failure isolation is already present.

title: Edit link dialog becomes an empty panel when its shape is deleted or deselected
reason: Reports an edit-link dialog becoming empty after its selected shape disappears through collaboration or another input path. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no equivalent edit-link dialog tied to a remotely mutable selected shape; the collaboration-dependent dialog lifecycle is outside its current feature set.
